name: tastly-food-recommender
description: Tastly — AI-powered food recommendations with conversational understanding, constraint-aware retrieval and CatBoost ranking.

paragraphs: Tastly helps people decide what to eat through conversational preferences, food retrieval, recommendation ranking and a restaurant map. Describe a dish, budget, distance or dietary preference, refine the request over several turns, and explore recommendations in Vietnamese or English.

Status: an integrated academic/demo application. The supplied catalog is a synthetic demo, not a verified directory of real restaurant menus. Menu availability, prices, nutrition, amenities and dietary suitability must not be treated as verified real-world facts. Some restaurant IDs and locations originate from source records; that does not verify their current accuracy.
features: AI1 — Constraint-aware food retrieval: filters a structured catalog using preferences, food matching, location and multilingual embedding similarity. Dataset IDs are preserved throughout the pipeline.

AI2 — LLM-first conversational understanding: uses OpenRouter for structured intent, preference updates and replies, then manages conversation state. Cloud fallback profiles and optional local Qwen support are…
AI3 — CatBoost recommendation ranking: scores retrieved candidates with the included CatBoost YetiRank model and its 15-feature schema.

Restaurant grouping: shows distinct restaurants with representative dishes. Primary results and supplementary suggestions are separate; supplementary results remain qualified alternatives rather than guaranteed matches…

Complete website: Next.js/React frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL accounts/sessions, synchronized search/chat preferences and map markers. Leaflet/OpenStreetMap works without a token; optional Mapbox adds its map…
